scope: Public full-group upload and complete pre-import inspection through IPC/actual CLI. No target asset publication, settings commit, receipt or device Apply. Finish/readback/reapply transport remains open.

contract.identity: 32 lowercase hex ID bound to target device/group/opaque owner revision/size. Fresh Begin requires current snapshot; retry returns same session. Status/Cancel/Release address stored target independently of attachment. Inspect returning after delayed admission is bound to original Entry, never a replacement session reusing its id.
contract.upload: Unlinked temporary file; chunks1..64KiB with absolute offset. Exact repeated offset+bytes acknowledged without append; changed repeated bytes/partial overlap terminally fail and close raw staging. Gaps/overflow/oversize/incomplete Inspect rejected before disk I/O.
contract.inspection: Checksum-checked typed manifest and correct group before full prepare_group; all payload hashes/decoders/remap validated in private temporary PersistenceStore. Temporary stores/assets/pins removed before Prepared. Target shared/legacy gallery inventory is unchanged. Summary logical remap IDs do not refer to target assets. Original uploaded file remains staged until Cancel/Release/expiry for a future Finish stage.
contract.ownership: Entry and global operation permits move into owned blocking worker; dropped RPC waiter cannot hide work. Status uses separate short metadata mutex, not file/decoder lock. Cancel sets cancelling and schedules serialized owned cleanup; reservation persists until actual raw-file/staging cleanup. Already running codec/filesystem operation is not forcibly interrupted. Panic monitor marks failed and closes staging. Late Release only removes the same Arc entry, preserving reused ids in both export/upload registries.

limits.budget_scope: Separate upload pool; export has its own reservation pool. Not a hard cap on all temporary codec files/memory.

contract.cli: profiles group inspect screen|fan-and-lighting FILE [--device]. Size/magic checked locally, streamed in chunks, exact reply binding/received checked, polling to validated Prepared. JSON contains metadata only; ID on stderr. Cancel/Release cleanup requested with bounded waiting; no configuration Apply.

regressions.coverage: Actual memory RPC/DeviceManager/MockBackend and real archive codec: incomplete/gap, exact repeated Chunk, changed duplicate -> failed, foreign target/group, idempotent Begin, wrong archive group and corrupt manifest, valid Screen gallery-only image in private quarantine, unchanged target catalogs/owner snapshots/receipt/PWM count and cleanup.

Held blocking operation, abandoned waiter, Cancel -> cancelling; third MAX reservation rejected while real work held; Status available; after release work exits/cancellation completes and capacity available again.

Extended existing actual lconnectctl/private Unix socket test: full Screen archive >1MiB uploaded/inspected, source sparse slot2 in typed summary, wrong group rejected, owner snapshot/receipts unchanged. Existing backup/clean-store decode/manual0/no-overwrite paths remain passing.

checks.gui: NOT RUN; no native/browser session or frontend changes
checks.hardware: NOT RUN; deferred by user, no physical device accessed

remaining: Finish/owner receipt/readback/reapply transport and CLI; target publication/preflight/commit/Apply using ready actors
Runtime job admission before public Finish, unknown storage/partial install reconciliation and production lifecycle faults
Export/import GUI and native signal/expiry/stalled-backend/shutdown fault acceptance
Windows ZIP decoder/mapping, remaining basic parity roadmap; extra LCD effects/Style Express last
